# gitmoap_repository_access_grant (Resource)

Names up to 50 subjects, with an optional expiry (in the future, at most a year away) and reason. Callers who can manage access here may call it (Maintainers and above with the built-in roles), and nobody can give a role carrying a permission or rank they do not hold themselves. A subject that already holds the same role is reported as unchanged; one holding a different role is refused. A service account can be given access only at its own group or repository or beneath it, and never as Owner. With `dry_run=true` the answer says who would gain what, and nothing changes.

The token needs `access:manage` and `access:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

resource "gitmoap_role" "reviewer" {
  group_id  = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
  slug      = "reviewer"
  name      = "Reviewer"
  base_role = "reporter"
}

data "gitmoap_user_by_username" "grace" {
  username = "grace"
}

# Grace reviews the api repository, with a custom role, until the migration is done.
resource "gitmoap_repository_access_grant" "grace" {
  repo_id    = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  subject    = { principal = data.gitmoap_user_by_username.grace.user_id }
  role       = { custom = gitmoap_role.reviewer.role_id }
  expires_at = "2027-03-31T00:00:00Z"
  reason     = "Reviewing the v2 migration"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID
- `role` (Attributes) A role, as a grant names it: `{ "builtin": "developer" }` or `{ "custom": "<role id>" }`.

Set one of `builtin` or `custom`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role))
- `subject` (Attributes) Who receives the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subject))

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) When the access ends. Omit it for access that lasts until it is revoked.
- `reason` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `grant_id` (String)
- `granted_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--granted_by))
- `last_exercised_at` (String) When the grant last let somebody do something, to the day. Absent until it has.
- `scope` (Attributes) A group or repository, as the access API names one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role`

Optional:

- `builtin` (String)
- `custom` (String)

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The role's display name: a built-in name such as `Developer`, or the custom role's name.
- `rank` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--subject"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subject`

Optional:

- `principal` (String)
- `team` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--granted_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `granted_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.


<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Read-Only:

- `full_path` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `inherits_access` (Boolean) Whether access granted on the groups above reaches it. When it is `false`, only access
granted here — and the organization's owners — reach it.
- `type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its repo_id and grant_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_repository_access_grant.example "<repo_id>/<grant_id>"
```
